A woman who is kind, supportive, and doesn't treat him like an enemy he has to constantly prove himself to. It's funny how women twist normal relationship expectations into extremes. A guy says he wants a feminine, caring woman, suddenly it's, oh, so you want a maid. He says he likes a woman who listens and supports him, oh, so you want a therapist. No, he just wants a partner who actually likes him. And let's not act like women's standards are simple either. But God forbid he asks for basic femininity, suddenly it's toxic masculinity. Guys, don't fall for this narrative.
